annotations.description: No host identity samples for 5 minutes, sustained for another 5 minutes. Check host reachability, Alloy, its certificate and Beacon ingestion; absence is not proof the host is powered off.
Ready has remained false or unknown for 5 minutes. Check node conditions, kubelet and networking before taking action. Missing node-status metrics are not evaluated by this rule.
Argo reports Degraded or Missing for 10 minutes. Inspect application conditions and affected workloads. OutOfSync alone is deliberately excluded; do not automatically sync or prune.
Less than 10% available space on a writable Linux root filesystem for 15 minutes. Inspect usage and retention before deleting anything. OPNsense and non-root volumes are outside this initial rule.
